definitions.gloss: sky blue; azure; light blue like the sky
definitions.explanation: A light, clear blue color resembling the sky on a sunny day. One of the traditional Japanese color names.

examples.japanese: {空色|そらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{空色|そらいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}り{替|か}えた→塗り替える：06270_nurikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I repainted the wall sky blue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧{空色|そらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧グラデーション⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しく→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧{見|み}とれて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The gradation of sky blue visible from the window was so beautiful that I gazed at it for a while.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (sky) and ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). One of the traditional Japanese color names ({和色|わしょく}), referring to the clear light blue of a fair-weather sky. It can function as an adjective with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (e.g., {空色|そらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空色|そらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: sky-blue flowers
- {空色|そらいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: sky-blue eyes
- {空色|そらいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed sky blue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水色|みずいろ}→水色：15336_mizuiro⟧: light blue — very similar shade; ⟦{水色|みずいろ}→水色：15336_mizuiro⟧ is the more common everyday term for light blue
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧: blue — the general term for blue; covers a wider range of shades
- ⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧: dark blue; navy — a much darker blue than {空色|そらいろ}
- ⟦{藍色|あいいろ}→藍色：15519_aiiro⟧: indigo — a deep blue-purple traditional color
